TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT PER_JOBS.JOB_ID, PER_JOBS.BUSINESS_GROUP_ID, PER_JOBS.JOB_DEFINITION_ID, PER_JOBS.DATE_FROM, PER_JOBS.DATE_TO, PER_JOBS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS CHANGED_ON_DT, PER_JOBS.LAST_UPDATED_BY, PER_JOBS.CREATED_BY, PER_JOBS.CREATION_DATE, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS AUX1_CHANGED_ON_DT, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT2, $$FLEX_JOB_EEO_CATEGORY EEO_CATEGORY, $$FLEX_JOB_FLSA_STATUS FLSA_STATUS, $$JOBFAMILYCODE_FLXFLD_SEGMENT_COL AS JOB_FAMILY_CODE, $$JOB_NAME_SEGMENT_COL AS JOB_NAME, PER_JOBS.NAME as JOB_CODE, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT6 END JOB_LEVEL, $$FLEX_JOB_FUNCTION AS JOB_FUNCTION, $$FLEX_JOB_FAMILY AS JOB_FAMILY, $$PROJ_JOB_LEVEL AS PROJ_JOB_LEVEL , '0' AS X_CUSTOM, PJFC.US_JOB_FAMILY, PJFC.JOB_CATEGORY, PJFC.Jacobs_Career_Level, PJFC.WTW_Career_Level, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT1 AS X_JOB_CATEGORY_CODE, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT4 AS X_JOB_FAMILY_CODE, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT5 AS X_SPECIALITY_CODE, PJFC.X_SPECIALITY_DESC, PJFC.JOB_LEVEL_DESC ,PJFC.X_JOB_BAND_DESC FROM (select pj.JOB_ID ,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs , APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_SUB_JOB_FAM' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT4) US_JOB_FAMILY , (SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs , APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JOB_CODE_2' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT1) JOB_CATEGORY ,(SELECT flv.meaning FROM per_jobs pj1, apps.fnd_lookup_values flv WHERE 1=1 AND pj1.attribute12 = flv.lookup_code AND flv.lookup_type = 'JEG_HR_CAREER_LEVEL' AND flv.language = 'US' AND pj.name = pj1.name AND pj1.business_group_id =0) Jacobs_Career_Level ,(SELECT flv.meaning FROM per_jobs pj1, apps.fnd_lookup_values flv WHERE 1=1 AND pj1.attribute13 = flv.lookup_code AND flv.lookup_type = 'JEG_HR_WTW_CAREER_LEVEL' AND flv.language = 'US' AND pj.name = pj1.name AND pj1.business_group_id =0) WTW_Career_Level ,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_SPECIALTY' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT5) X_SPECIALITY_DESC
,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_LEVEL' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT6) JOB_LEVEL_DESC ,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION ----Added for Job band desc FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_GCS_BAND' AND ffvv.flex_value = substr(pjd.SEGMENT6, 2, 1)) X_JOB_BAND_DESC
from per_jobs pj,per_job_definitions pjd where pj.job_definition_id = pjd.job_definition_id) PJFC, PER_JOBS, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS WHERE PER_JOBS.JOB_DEFINITION_ID = PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.JOB_DEFINITION_ID AND PJFC.JOB_ID = PER_JOBS.JOB_ID

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: This Mapping Extracts the Job information from Oracle Apps into the staging area table.The Job dimension table describes different jobs (not positions) in an organization and also is used for EEO reporting. For example, Manager is a job as opposed to Senior Manager Sales Western Region San Jose Office, which is a position. Jobs define the role that an employee can perform in the business group, and they are independent of specific organizations

JOB_LEVEL, $$FLEX_JOB_FUNCTION AS JOB_FUNCTION, $$FLEX_JOB_FAMILY AS JOB_FAMILY, $$PROJ_JOB_LEVEL AS PROJ_JOB_LEVEL , '0' AS X_CUSTOM, PJFC.US_JOB_FAMILY, PJFC.JOB_CATEGORY, PJFC.Jacobs_Career_Level, PJFC.WTW_Career_Level, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT1 AS X_JOB_CATEGORY_CODE, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT4 AS X_JOB_FAMILY_CODE, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.SEGMENT5 AS X_SPECIALITY_CODE, PJFC.X_SPECIALITY_DESC, PJFC.JOB_LEVEL_DESC ,PJFC.X_JOB_BAND_DESC ,PJFC.X_JOB_FAM_STEM_FLG ,PJFC.X_SUB_JOBSTEM_FLG FROM (select pj.JOB_ID ,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM pjd.SEGMENT4) US_JOB_FAMILY , (SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs , APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JOB_CODE_2' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT1) JOB_CATEGORY ,(SELECT flv.meaning FROM per_jobs pj1, apps.fnd_lookup_values flv WHERE 1=1 AND pj1.attribute12 = flv.lookup_code AND flv.lookup_type = 'JEG_HR_CAREER_LEVEL' AND flv.language = 'US' AND pj.name = pj1.name AND pj1.business_group_id =0) Jacobs_Career_Level ,(SELECT flv.meaning FROM per_jobs pj1, apps.fnd_lookup_values flv WHERE 1=1 AND pj1.attribute13 = flv.lookup_code AND flv.lookup_type = 'JEG_HR_WTW_CAREER_LEVEL' AND flv.language = 'US' AND pj.name = pj1.name AND pj1.business_group_id =0) WTW_Career_Level ,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_SPECIALTY' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT5) X_SPECIALITY_DESC
,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_LEVEL' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT6) JOB_LEVEL_DESC
,(SELECT ffvv.LAST_UPDATE_DATE as LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_LEVEL' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT6) LAST_UPDATE_DATE
,(SELECT ffvv.description as CODE_DESCRIPTION ----Added for Job band desc FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_GCS_BAND' AND ffvv.flex_value = substr(pjd.SEGMENT6, 2, 1)) X_JOB_BAND_DESC ,(SELECT ffvv.attribute1 FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JOB_CODE_2' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT1) X_JOB_FAM_STEM_FLG , (SELECT ffvv.attribute1 FROM APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUE_SETS ffvs, APPS.FND_FLEX_VALUES_VL ffvv WHERE ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID = ffvv.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID AND ffvs.FLEX_VALUE_SET_NAME = 'JEG_JC_SUB_JOB_FAM' AND ffvv.flex_value = pjd.SEGMENT4) X_SUB_JOBSTEM_FLG from per_jobs pj,per_job_definitions pjd where pj.job_definition_id = pjd.job_definition_id) PJFC, PER_JOBS, PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS ,PER_JOB_GROUPS WHERE (PER_JOBS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') OR PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') OR PJFC.LAST_UPDATE_DATE >= TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') ) AND PER_JOBS.JOB_DEFINITION_ID = PER_JOB_DEFINITIONS.JOB_DEFINITION_ID AND PER_JOB_GROUPS.JOB_GROUP_ID = PER_JOBS.JOB_GROUP_ID AND PJFC.JOB_ID = PER_JOBS.JOB_ID AND SUBSTR(PER_JOB_GROUPS.DISPLAYED_NAME,1,3) IN ('JEG', 'HR_')
